text:
marco: Quick heads up: small policy tweak to ratecard V4.0 going live next week. Main changes: trial credits expire at 90 days (was 180), and we clarified how discount bands stack for multi-SKU deals. Need deal desk + finance ack before we publish.
anya-sales: 90 days is a big change for some of our POCs. Can we add a grandfather window for active trials started before the publish date?
kevin-dealdesk: Good call. Propose: trials started before publish date keep 180d, new trials 90d. We also need a clear approving flow for multi-SKU discounts >25%.
rachel-finance: Finance needs to know: do expired trial credits auto-forfeit, or do we convert to a one-time account credit? That affects revenue deferral.
marco: Plan is auto-forfeit for expired trials. We added language to prevent carryover. Rationale: reduces AR complexity for small trials.
olga-billing: Billing ops: please confirm how we'll surface forfeited credits on invoices. Need a line item code so accounting can track.
marco: Suggested invoice text: "Trial credit forfeited (expired)". Will send GL mapping to #finance in a minute.
rachel-finance: Also request GL tag: TRIAL_EXP_FORFEIT. Add to mapping spreadsheet.
kevin-dealdesk: Approvals: multi-SKU discounts >25% require deal desk + finance sign-off; >40% also needs legal review. We'll add this into the request form.
sam-legal: Note: if discounts cross product families, we should include language prohibiting implied assignment of credits. I'll draft a 1-liner.
marco: Draft line for docs: "Trial credits are valid for the trialing account only and are non-transferable. Expired trial credits are forfeited and are not convertible to monetary refunds or transferable credits."
anya-sales: AE one-liner for customers? Something short we can paste: "We're tightening trial windows to 90 days for new trials; existing trials started before <publish_date> keep the previous 180-day window. Let us know if you need an exception."
kevin-dealdesk: Slight tweak: replace "tightening" with "standardizing" to keep tone neutral.
marco: Updated. Also adding a small examples table into ratecard doc so AEs don't misapply discounts. Example block:

```
Example A: Customer buys Model API + Embeddings. Discount band applied per-product family; no cross-family stacking.
Example B: Add-on support credits are billed separately and do not consume commit credits.
```

olga-billing: For auto-processing, ops needs the SKU groups. I'll paste a CSV template in #eng-ops after we lock.
rachel-finance: Approve subject to GL tagging and exportability for audits.
kevin-dealdesk: Approve from deal desk side. We'll enforce >25% rule in the form.
sam-legal: Legal thumbs-up on the snippet; will add the anti-assignment sentence.
deal-desk-bot: Reminder: submit Deal Desk request with label `ratecard-v4.0` for any exception. Include: customer, sku_groups, discount_pct, trial_start_date, reason. Link: https://redwood/deal-desk/new :robot_face:
billing-bot: Billing ops will ingest CSV once posted. Please tag @olga-billing in PRs.
marco: Final checklist: finance GL mapping + tag (rachel), billing SKU csv (olga), deal desk form rule (kevin), legal snippet (sam). If we have all ok by EOD Wednesday we'll publish next Monday.
anya-sales: We'll flag key POCs. thanks.
kevin-dealdesk: locking in approvals now.
